messages.content: 給我2013年刑法修正案的詳細內容。

function.name: get_act_details
function.description: Retrieve the details of a particular legal act based on its name and year of amendment if any. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

amendment_year.description: Year of amendment if any. If not provided, the latest amendment year will be considered.

message.reasoning: The user wants the details of the 2013 amendment to the criminal law. They likely refer to Taiwan's Criminal Code amendments? Or maybe Chinese criminal law? The user wrote in Chinese: "給我2013年刑法修正案的詳細內容。" That means "Give me the detailed content of the 2013 Criminal Law Amendment." Which jurisdiction? Could be Taiwan's 2013 amendment to the Criminal Code (刑法修正案). In Taiwan, there was a Criminal Code amendment in 2013? Actually Taiwan's Criminal Code was amended in 2013? Let's recall: Taiwan's Criminal Code was amended in 2013? I think there was a Criminal Code amendment in 2013 (刑法修正案). It might be the "刑法修正案（七）" or something. But the user didn't specify the jurisdiction. We can ask clarifying question. But the instruction says we should not ask clarifying question unless necessary. But we need to provide the details. We can use the function get_act_details. The function requires act_name and amendment_year. So we can call get_act_details with act_name: "刑法" and amendment_year: 2013. That should retrieve details. Let's do that.
